overview_description.description:
Paragon is an embedded integration platform for SaaS apps, enabling companies to build products that integrate with the SaaS ecosystem. With Paragon, software companies can integrate with hundreds of different SaaS apps in minutes while providing their customers with a seamless, unified integration experience. Paragon's vision is to build the connecting layer for all software that enables every application in the world to work together seamlessly.

In the last year, they've grown by over 6x and now work with nearly 100 customers around the world. They've raised over $3.5M from world-class investors like Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, Soma Capital, and Village Global, and have been featured in Techcrunch and Forbes.

about_short_description.short_description: Paragon is an embedded integration platform for SaaS apps, enabling companies to build products that integrate with the SaaS ecosystem.

product.name: Embedded SDK
product.description: An SDK that enables embedding third-party app integrations and configuration directly within a product, allowing users to connect apps with a few clicks.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: A visual and code-based workflow builder for creating custom integration logic to ingest, sync, and automate data transfer across connected apps.

product.name: ActionKit
product.description: An API providing over 1000 integration actions for AI agents to query and act on users' third-party applications.

product.name: Managed Sync
product.description: A service that ingests full replicas of customers’ external data with normalized schemas, supporting historical and incremental syncs for AI and structured data use cases.

product.name: Permissions API
product.description: An API to enforce third-party permissions in data retrieval pipelines, checking user access to documents and syncing permissions regularly.

product.name: Connect Portal
product.description: A pre-built, embedded user interface component for managing authentication and configuration of third-party app integrations within a product.
